title: LCP Ack Message
description: Response to any message. Uses errors[] array — a single message can fail multiple field validations. Created by Spear Systems (a Spear company). Open standard — Apache 2.0, free to implement.

original_message_id.description: ID of the message being acknowledged.

errors.description: Zero or more error objects. Present when status = ERROR or REJECTED.

rejection_reason.description: Structured reason the lead was refused or not bought: with status = REJECTED, or (v1.3, LEP-0012) with disposition.outcome = unsold or price_rejected. Known values: invalid_phone, invalid_email, duplicate, out_of_geography, out_of_scope, credit_too_low, already_customer, data_quality_fail, compliance_fail, price_too_high, capacity_exceeded, consent_expired, litigator_flagged, no_buyer. Open enumeration.
rejection_reason.$comment: Open enum — enables publisher automation (route invalid_phone to retry, duplicate to dedup, etc.)

disposition.description: v1.3 (LEP-0012 §1): the commercial result of the acknowledged lead or post. A lead is sold if, and only if, outcome = sold. Sent only when the acknowledged message's lcp.version is 1.3.0 or later; a DUPLICATE ack repeats the original disposition. Classed restricted because redirect_url is session-bearing.

payout_cents.description: sold only: what the receiver will pay the sender for this lead, in minor units of currency, after any receiver fee.

counter_price_cents.description: price_rejected only: the lowest price the receiver would pay. Informational in v1.3.

redirect_url.description: sold only: the consumer's next page. The sender sends the consumer's browser there as a top-level navigation and never fetches it server-side (LEP-0012 §2). Never logged.

final_by.description: pending only: the latest time the final ACCEPTED or REJECTED event will be sent.

negotiation.description: LEP-0009 §5: the negotiation outcome carried on every ack for a quote/counter (and on the bid ack of a successful redemption), so a buyer never infers state from prose. Absent on a v1.1 exchange.

price_cents.description: The accepted, countered, or refused price; absent on a refusal that carried no price.

binding_token.description: Present only when outcome = accepted. Single-use; returned exactly once (the ack to the accepting message). The platform stores only a hash.

binding_expires_at.description: At or before the negotiation expires_at; the token is unusable at or after this instant.
